subject: Error in running attemping to run a for loop

messages.author: a4e2cc09f1e031bc
messages.subject: Error in running attemping to run a for loop
parts:
Hi all,

I have a very nuanced, but annoying issue. I am attempting to write a for loop, where I write the timeperiods.txt file in R, such that I can pull one of the numbers from a uniform distribution. I am effectively trying to estimate where likelihood is maximized given a random start date, as a hypothesis testing framework given the tree. I have had success in this front and can run the code in its entirety, but when I place it into a for loop and specifically when I run the following code:

BioGeoBEARS_run_object <- section_the_tree(inputs=BioGeoBEARS_run_object, plot_pieces=FALSE, cut_fossils=FALSE)

I get this fatal error:

Error in section_the_tree(inputs = BioGeoBEARS_run_object, plot_pieces = FALSE,  : 
  STOP ERROR in section_the_tree(): the timeperiods file *HAS* to have an oldest time that is older than the bottom node in your tree.  Use the function prt() to get a table of node ages for your tree. The oldest node age in your tree is: 159.103925948033. The times in your timeperiods file are: .' (note that the oldest age is 165.0)

If I run this:

BioGeoBEARS_run_object <- readfiles_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)

and then immediately repeat the section_the_tree again, then it reads it in correctly. However, this above fatal stop error stops my for loop and doesnt allow my code to get to the next line that reads it in correctly. I have been trying to use the try() function, but that has not been working for this. Any and all help with this would be greatly appreciated.

Best,

Brenen
